blocks.en: Chapter 4a: Architecture & Layout, Part 1 (4.1–4.3)

blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 4.1 Introduction 4.1 簡介
blocks.en: 4.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 第四章 引言
blocks.en: Chapter Introduction

blocks.zh: 本章探討整合設計的重要性，並檢視設施佈局、建築細部與飾面要求。本章的核心概念是風險評估及其如何融入設施設計。
blocks.en: This chapter discusses the importance of integrated design and examines facility layout, building details and finish requirements. The core concept of the chapter is risk assessment and how it is built into facility design.

blocks.zh: 風險評估應適當評估產品面臨風險的環節，並透過設施設計方法來因應與降低潛在的化學或生物污染。
blocks.en: The risk assessment should appropriately evaluate where the product is exposed to risk, and the facility design approach should address and reduce potential chemical or biological contamination.

blocks.zh: 三大設計方法
blocks.en: Three Design Approaches

blocks.zh: 空間（物理）分隔 — 透過實體屏障將潔淨區與非潔淨區隔離
blocks.en: Spatial (physical) separation — isolating clean areas from non-clean areas with physical barriers

blocks.zh: 程序手段 — 透過 SOP、操作培訓與工作指令進行控制
blocks.en: Procedural means — control through SOPs, operator training and work instructions

blocks.zh: 時間分隔（戰役式生產） — 不同產品或操作在不同時段進行，中間施以清潔與換氣
blocks.en: Temporal separation (campaign manufacturing) — different products or operations are run at different times, with cleaning and air changeover in between

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院手術室的無菌保護
blocks.en: Analogy: Sterile Protection in a Hospital Operating Room

blocks.zh: 想像一間手術室：物理分隔就像無菌門與玄關；程序手段就像洗手與穿手術衣流程；時間分隔就像在兩台手術之間進行手術室消毒。三者都是為了保護病人（產品）免受污染。
blocks.en: Picture an operating room: physical separation is like the sterile doors and vestibule; procedural means are like the handwashing and gowning routine; temporal separation is like disinfecting the room between two operations. All three exist to protect the patient (the product) from contamination.

blocks.zh: 三類基本無菌生產模式：
blocks.en: Three basic types of sterile manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 開放式無菌生產：產品暴露於環境（如隔離器內的裝填操作）
blocks.en: Open aseptic manufacturing: the product is exposed to the environment (e.g., filling operations inside an isolator)

blocks.zh: 密閉式無菌生產：產品在密封管路與容器內流轉
blocks.en: Closed aseptic manufacturing: the product is transferred within sealed piping and containers

blocks.zh: 開放式非無菌生產：最終滅菌產品，仍需控制生物負荷
blocks.en: Open non-sterile manufacturing: terminally sterilized products, where bioburden must still be controlled

blocks.zh: 4.1.1 Facility Design Approaches 4.1.1 廠房設計方法
blocks.en: 4.1.1 Facility Design Approaches

blocks.zh: 4.1.1 設施設計方法
blocks.en: 4.1.1 Facility Design Approaches

blocks.zh: 本指南推薦在可行情況下優先使用空間分隔來維護 ISO 5/Grade A 環境的保護。
blocks.en: The guide recommends giving preference to spatial separation, where practicable, to maintain protection of the ISO 5/Grade A environment.

blocks.zh: 重點：隔離器 vs. RABS 對周圍環境的影響
blocks.en: Key point: Impact of Isolators vs. RABS on the Surrounding Environment

blocks.zh: 隔離器：周圍房間與產品完全隔離，房間等級可降低（ISO 8/Grade C 或更低）
blocks.en: Isolator: the surrounding room is completely separated from the product, so the room classification can be lowered (ISO 8/Grade C or lower)

blocks.zh: RABS：偶爾需開門，周圍環境仍需維持 ISO 7/Grade B，門開啟側需滿足 LP/GAAS 條件
blocks.en: RABS: doors are occasionally opened, so the surrounding environment must still be maintained at ISO 7/Grade B, and the door-opening side must meet LP/GAAS conditions

blocks.zh: 空間分隔的典型應用：
blocks.en: Typical applications of spatial separation:

blocks.zh: 開放製程置於隔離器或 RABS 內
blocks.en: Open processes placed inside an isolator or RABS

blocks.zh: 密閉製程系統（密封管路運送產品）
blocks.en: Closed process systems (product conveyed in sealed piping)

blocks.zh: 專用穿衣室：進入與離開分開，防止脫衣污染影響穿衣區
blocks.en: Dedicated gowning rooms: separate entry and exit, so that de-gowning contamination does not affect the gowning area

blocks.zh: 比喻：分隔方式的選擇
blocks.en: Analogy: Choosing a Separation Method

blocks.zh: 想像一家餐廳的廚房動線：進料口與出菜口分開（空間分隔）是最佳方案；但小餐廳可能只能用同一個門但錯開時間（時間分隔）。廠房規模與風險決定了哪種方法最適合。
blocks.en: Think of the workflow in a restaurant kitchen: separate doors for incoming ingredients and outgoing dishes (spatial separation) is the best solution; but a small restaurant may only have one door and stagger the timing (temporal separation). Facility size and risk determine which approach is most suitable.

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 Design Approach Implementation 4.1.2 設計方法實施
blocks.en: 4.1.2 Design Approach Implementation

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 設計方法實施
blocks.en: 4.1.2 Design Approach Implementation

blocks.zh: 開放式無菌製造有三種基本設施類型：
blocks.en: There are three basic facility types for open aseptic manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 重點：隔離器技術的節省效果
blocks.en: Key point: Savings from Isolator Technology

blocks.zh: 使用隔離器時，可能減少的項目：
blocks.en: When isolators are used, the following may be reduced:

blocks.zh: 房間空氣分級與監測要求
blocks.en: Room air classification and monitoring requirements

blocks.zh: 穿衣等級要求
blocks.en: Gowning level requirements

blocks.zh: 氣閘與穿衣室數量
blocks.en: Number of airlocks and gowning rooms

blocks.zh: 清潔範圍與頻率
blocks.en: Cleaning scope and frequency

blocks.zh: 房間飾面與細部要求（但仍需滿足最低標準）
blocks.en: Room finishes and detail requirements (though minimum standards must still be met)

blocks.zh: 注意：物料流仍需控制
blocks.en: Note: Material flow must still be controlled

blocks.zh: 即使使用隔離器，物料、製程、人員、廢棄物和設備的移動路徑仍需適當分離，以防止混淆和交叉污染。風險評估應確定分離要求，特別是在多產品併行製造時。
blocks.en: Even with isolators, the movement paths of materials, process, personnel, waste and equipment must still be properly separated to prevent mix-ups and cross-contamination. The risk assessment should determine the separation requirements, especially when multiple products are manufactured concurrently.

blocks.zh: 4.1.3 Concurrent Production 4.1.3 同步生產
blocks.en: 4.1.3 Concurrent Production

blocks.zh: 4.1.3 併行生產
blocks.en: 4.1.3 Concurrent Production

blocks.zh: 多產品併行生產在技術上可行，但實際操作中混淆風險很高。
blocks.en: Concurrent production of multiple products is technically feasible, but in practice the risk of mix-ups is high.

blocks.zh: GMP 原則：工程手段優於程序手段
blocks.en: GMP principle: engineering controls are preferred over procedural controls

blocks.zh: GMP 規範一致推薦使用物理屏障與足夠空間來控制物料，而非僱仍依靠程序控制。將不同產品放在獨立房間是最穩健的工程解決方案。
blocks.en: GMP requirements consistently recommend using physical barriers and adequate space to control materials, rather than relying on procedural controls. Placing different products in separate rooms is the most robust engineering solution.

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚房的食材分隔
blocks.en: Analogy: Separating Ingredients in a Kitchen

blocks.zh: 就像食品工廠不會在同一工作台上同時處理花生和不含花生產品一樣，藥品工廠應將不同產品放在獨立房間，用物理屏障防止混淆。
blocks.en: Just as a food factory would not process peanut and peanut-free products on the same workbench, a pharmaceutical plant should place different products in separate rooms and use physical barriers to prevent mix-ups.

blocks.zh: 4.2 General Design Criteria 4.2 一般設計準則
blocks.en: 4.2 General Design Criteria

blocks.zh: 4.2 一般設計準則
blocks.en: 4.2 General Design Criteria

blocks.zh: 設施設計的雙重目標：保護產品免受污染，同時保護操作人員免受有害產品暴露。設計的起點是充分理解製造的產品。
blocks.en: Facility design has a dual objective: to protect the product from contamination, while protecting operators from exposure to hazardous products. The starting point of the design is a thorough understanding of the product being manufactured.

blocks.zh: 設計準則兩大類別
blocks.en: Two Categories of Design Criteria

blocks.zh: 製程與操作：產品類型、產量、設備、流向
blocks.en: Process and operations: product type, volume, equipment, flow

blocks.zh: 設施：場址、建築、整合配合
blocks.en: Facility: site, building, integration and fit

blocks.zh: 4.2.1 Process & Operational Considerations 4.2.1 製程與營運考量
blocks.en: 4.2.1 Process & Operational Considerations

blocks.zh: 4.2.1 製程與操作考量
blocks.en: 4.2.1 Process & Operational Considerations

blocks.zh: 操作哲學決定了設施的組織方式與佈局開發。以下是關鍵考量點的分類整理：
blocks.en: The operating philosophy determines how the facility is organized and how the layout is developed. Key considerations are grouped below:

blocks.zh: 產品與製程定義
blocks.en: Product and Process Definition

blocks.zh: 產品類型、產量與產能目標
blocks.en: Product type, volume and capacity targets

blocks.zh: 危害性與控制需求
blocks.en: Hazard and containment requirements

blocks.zh: 無菌 vs. 非無菌製程
blocks.en: Sterile vs. non-sterile processes

blocks.zh: 最終劑型：液體、凍乾粉末、無菌 API 粉末
blocks.en: Final dosage form: liquid, lyophilized powder, sterile API powder

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗 vs. 商業生產
blocks.en: Clinical trial vs. commercial production

blocks.zh: 設備與技術決策
blocks.en: Equipment and Technology Decisions

blocks.zh: 批次 vs. 連續製程（如批次洗瓶+烘箱 vs. 連續隧道）
blocks.en: Batch vs. continuous processes (e.g., batch washer + oven vs. continuous tunnel)

blocks.zh: 即用型組件（RTU 針筒、西林瓶、膠塞、封蓋）
blocks.en: Ready-to-use (RTU) components (syringes, vials, stoppers, caps)

blocks.zh: 一次性系統對倉儲的影響
blocks.en: Impact of single-use systems on storage

blocks.zh: 自動化程度（手動裝填為高風險，不建議）
blocks.en: Level of automation (manual filling is high risk and not recommended)

blocks.zh: RABS vs. 隔離器對佈局的影響
blocks.en: Impact of RABS vs. isolators on layout

blocks.zh: 開放製程使用 RABS 時，每個開放製程步驟應佔用獨立房間，需要更多樓地面積與更多潔淨 HVAC 分區。隔離器保護的製程則可與其他隔離器製程共用房間。
blocks.en: When RABS are used for open processes, each open process step should occupy its own room, requiring more floor area and more clean HVAC zones. Processes protected by isolators can share a room with other isolator processes.

blocks.zh: 4.2.2 Site & Building Considerations 4.2.2 廠址與建築考量
blocks.en: 4.2.2 Site & Building Considerations

blocks.zh: 4.2.2 場址與建築考量
blocks.en: 4.2.2 Site & Building Considerations

blocks.zh: 大多數專案都有場址限制。關鍵在於理解這些限制，並合理地將製程與操作需求整合到場址中。
blocks.en: Most projects have site constraints. The key is to understand these constraints and sensibly integrate the process and operational requirements into the site.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：車輛與進氣位置
blocks.en: Special attention: vehicles and air intake locations

blocks.zh: 卡車與大型車輛的交通動線對決定 HVAC 與製程壓縮空氣系統的進氣位置至關重要。進氣口應遠離排氣、車輛廢氣與飾塵源。
blocks.en: Truck and heavy vehicle traffic routes are critical in deciding the air intake locations for HVAC and process compressed air systems. Air intakes should be located away from exhausts, vehicle exhaust fumes and sources of dust.

blocks.zh: 常見專案場景
blocks.en: Common Project Scenarios

blocks.zh: 新建（Green Field）：最大設計自由度
blocks.en: New build (green field): maximum design freedom

blocks.zh: 既有建築改造：受結構、樓高、柱距限制
blocks.en: Renovation of an existing building: limited by structure, floor height and column spacing

blocks.zh: 既有裝填套件改裝：最嚴格的限制，需在原有框架內最佳化
blocks.en: Retrofit of an existing filling suite: the most restrictive case, requiring optimization within the existing framework

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 Facility Fit Considerations 4.2.3 設施適配性考量
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Facility Fit Considerations

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 設施適配考量
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Facility Fit Considerations

blocks.zh: 將製程與操作需求整合到專案場址是專案成功的關鍵。這個過程稱為設施建模（Facility Modeling）。
blocks.en: Integrating the process and operational requirements into the project site is key to project success. This process is called facility modeling.

blocks.zh: 除了生產區域外，設計者還應考慮：
blocks.en: In addition to production areas, designers should consider:

blocks.zh: 設備維護空間
blocks.en: Space for equipment maintenance

blocks.zh: 工程技術區域（機械夹層、管道通道）
blocks.en: Engineering and technical areas (mechanical interstitial spaces, pipe chases)

blocks.zh: 操作支援區域（清潔室、倉庫、人員支援）
blocks.en: Operational support areas (cleaning rooms, warehouse, personnel support)

blocks.zh: 4.3 Layout Considerations 4.3 配置考量
blocks.en: 4.3 Layout Considerations

blocks.zh: 4.3 佈局考量
blocks.en: 4.3 Layout Considerations

blocks.zh: 設計師應遵循四步驟規劃流程：
blocks.en: Designers should follow a four-step planning process:

blocks.zh: 佈局設計四步驟
blocks.en: Four Steps of Layout Design

blocks.zh: 定義目標與目的 — 支持專案商業案例
blocks.en: Define the goals and objectives — support the project business case

blocks.zh: 理解產品與製程 — 產生方塊流程圖與專案程式書
blocks.en: Understand the product and process — produce block flow diagrams and the project facility program

blocks.zh: 建立分區與轉換圖 — 定義區域分級轉換與氣流方向
blocks.en: Establish zoning and transition diagrams — define area classification transitions and airflow direction

blocks.zh: 發展概念佈局 — 整合設備配置與分區規則
blocks.en: Develop the conceptual layout — integrate equipment arrangement and zoning rules

blocks.zh: 比喻：佈局設計如城市規劃
blocks.en: Analogy: Layout Design as City Planning

blocks.zh: 佈局設計如同規劃一座城市：先確定功能分區（住宅、商業、工業），再規劃交通動線（物料流與人員流），最後布置具體建築（設備配置）。分區圖就是城市的都市計畫法，確保各區域間的轉換合理。
blocks.en: Layout design is like planning a city: first determine the functional zones (residential, commercial, industrial), then plan the traffic routes (material flow and personnel flow), and finally place the individual buildings (equipment arrangement). The zoning diagram is the city's urban planning law, ensuring that transitions between zones make sense.

blocks.zh: 設施程式書（Facility Program）範例：
blocks.en: Example of a facility program:

blocks.zh: 4.3.4 轉換與分區圖
blocks.en: 4.3.4 Transition and Zoning Diagrams

blocks.zh: 轉換與分區圖識別所有影響單元操作的區域，定義其相互關係，並建立最能符合 GMP 和操作員需求的流動模式。
blocks.en: The transition and zoning diagram identifies all areas that affect unit operations, defines their interrelationships, and establishes the flow patterns that best meet GMP and operator needs.

blocks.zh: 分區圖的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Key Elements of a Zoning Diagram

blocks.zh: 區域分級：每個房間的潔淨等級
blocks.en: Area classification: the cleanliness grade of each room

blocks.zh: 氣流方向：從高潔淨區流向低潔淨區（壓力梯度）
blocks.en: Airflow direction: from higher-cleanliness areas to lower-cleanliness areas (pressure cascade)

blocks.zh: 氣閘配置：每個區域轉換點的氣閘設計
blocks.en: Airlock arrangement: airlock design at each area transition point

blocks.zh: 人員與物料路徑：清楚定義的動線
blocks.en: Personnel and material paths: clearly defined routes

blocks.zh: 空間規劃：設計師應開發功能房間佈局，圖解支援操作所需的面積。團隊應評估未來技術或產能擴充對空間的影響。
blocks.en: Space planning: designers should develop a functional room layout that illustrates the area needed to support operations. The team should evaluate the space impact of future technology or capacity expansion.

blocks.zh: 設備配置：設備配置協助確定房間大小、結構柱距和通道路線。需要建築師、工程師與設備供應商共同協作。
blocks.en: Equipment arrangement: the equipment arrangement helps determine room sizes, structural column spacing and routes for access. It requires collaboration among architects, engineers and equipment suppliers.

blocks.zh: 4.3.7 Material/Personnel Flows 4.3.7 物料/人員動線
blocks.en: 4.3.7 Material/Personnel Flows

blocks.zh: 4.3.7 物料流與人員流
blocks.en: 4.3.7 Material and Personnel Flows

blocks.zh: 人員與物料流的設計應最大程度降低污染物進入潔淨區的風險。
blocks.en: Personnel and material flows should be designed to minimize the risk of contaminants entering clean areas.

blocks.zh: 物料流設計原則
blocks.en: Material Flow Design Principles

blocks.zh: 單向流：開放製程區域應採用單向流動
blocks.en: Unidirectional flow: open process areas should use unidirectional flow

blocks.zh: 禁止雙向同步流：透過門聯鎖、指示燈、警報防止
blocks.en: No simultaneous two-way flow: prevented by door interlocks, indicator lights and alarms

blocks.zh: 廢棄物路徑：不得經過產品暴露區
blocks.en: Waste routes: must not pass through product-exposed areas

blocks.zh: 製程中暫存：應提供適當空間
blocks.en: In-process holding: adequate space should be provided

blocks.zh: 避免混淆：組件流動路徑應合理明確
blocks.en: Avoid mix-ups: component flow paths should be logical and clear

blocks.zh: 人員流設計原則
blocks.en: Personnel Flow Design Principles

blocks.zh: 穿衣合規：每次進入必須經過控制的穿衣區
blocks.en: Gowning compliance: every entry must go through a controlled gowning area

blocks.zh: 氣閘與跨越式更衣椅：門聯鎖防止同時雙向通行
blocks.en: Airlocks and step-over benches: door interlocks prevent simultaneous two-way passage

blocks.zh: 單向人員流：產品暴露區域必須單向
blocks.en: Unidirectional personnel flow: required in product-exposed areas

blocks.zh: 最小化干預：減少對臨界區的人員介入
blocks.en: Minimize interventions: reduce personnel interventions in critical areas

blocks.zh: 安全注意：跨越椅 vs. 逃生路徑
blocks.en: Safety note: step-over benches vs. escape routes

blocks.zh: GMP 要求的跨越式更衣椅不應放在緊急逃生路徑上，因為它們可能被視為絆倒危險。應考慮使用物料氣閘或獨立緊急門作為逃生路徑。
blocks.en: GMP-required step-over benches should not be placed in emergency escape routes, because they may be considered a tripping hazard. Consider using a material airlock or a separate emergency door as the escape route.

blocks.zh: 4.3.8 Additional Layout Considerations 4.3.8 其他配置考量
blocks.en: 4.3.8 Additional Layout Considerations

blocks.zh: 4.3.8 附加佈局考量
blocks.en: 4.3.8 Additional Layout Considerations

blocks.zh: 除了流動設計外，佈局還應處理以下問題：
blocks.en: In addition to flow design, the layout should address the following issues:

blocks.zh: 關鍵規則：潔淨室與外牆
blocks.en: Key rule: cleanrooms and exterior walls

blocks.zh: ISO 8/Grade C 或更高等級的潔淨室不應直接緊鄰外牆。原因包括：
blocks.en: Cleanrooms of ISO 8/Grade C or higher should not be directly adjacent to exterior walls. Reasons include:

blocks.zh: 濕氣滲透/凝結風險
blocks.en: Risk of moisture penetration/condensation

blocks.zh: 害蟲入侵風險
blocks.en: Risk of pest ingress

blocks.zh: 風力對房間壓力的影響
blocks.en: Effect of wind on room pressure

blocks.zh: 管路與服務配置原則
blocks.en: Principles for Piping and Services Arrangement

blocks.zh: 穿越潔淨區的管路應集中配置，使用歧管板
blocks.en: Piping passing through clean areas should be concentrated, using manifold panels

blocks.zh: 管路與服務配置盡量放在潔淨室外的獨立管道室
blocks.en: Piping and services should preferably be located in separate service rooms outside the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 分配水平與垂直管道區域
blocks.en: Allocate horizontal and vertical service zones

blocks.zh: 無菌區域嚴禁事項
blocks.en: Prohibitions in Aseptic Areas

blocks.zh: ISO 7/Grade B 和 ISO 5/Grade A 區域禁止開放式水槽與排水口
blocks.en: Open sinks and drains are prohibited in ISO 7/Grade B and ISO 5/Grade A areas

blocks.zh: 水平面應盡量減少，防止微粒積累與干擾單向氣流（UAF）
blocks.en: Horizontal surfaces should be minimized to prevent particle accumulation and disruption of unidirectional airflow (UAF)

blocks.zh: 真空系統的主機不得放在 ISO 5 或 ISO 7 區域內
blocks.en: The main unit of a vacuum system must not be located in an ISO 5 or ISO 7 area

blocks.zh: 4.3.9–4.3.10 Cost Optimization & Fire Protection 4.3.9–4.3.10 成本最佳化與消防
blocks.en: 4.3.9–4.3.10 Cost Optimization & Fire Protection

blocks.zh: 4.3.9 成本最佳化佈局
blocks.en: 4.3.9 Cost-Optimized Layout

blocks.zh: 外部建築形狀：簡單的平面形狀最經濟。正方形平面在相同面積下週長最小，外牆成本最低。
blocks.en: Exterior building shape: a simple plan shape is the most economical. For the same area, a square plan has the smallest perimeter and therefore the lowest exterior wall cost.

blocks.zh: 建築高度與成本關係
blocks.en: Relationship Between Building Height and Cost

blocks.zh: 樓層增加 → 每平方米平均成本上升
blocks.en: More floors → higher average cost per square meter

blocks.zh: 超過四層時結構成本急劇增加
blocks.en: Structural costs increase sharply above four floors

blocks.zh: 環境與服務隨建築複雜度與高度增加而變得更貴
blocks.en: Envelope and services become more expensive as building complexity and height increase

blocks.zh: 關鍵成本原則：無菌區面積最小化
blocks.en: Key cost principle: minimize the aseptic area

blocks.zh: 無菌區域（含 HVAC 服務）的整體成本顯著高於設施其他部分。在不影響製造效率的前提下，應盡量縮小無菌區面積。
blocks.en: The overall cost of aseptic areas (including HVAC services) is significantly higher than that of the rest of the facility. Without compromising manufacturing efficiency, the aseptic area should be kept as small as possible.

blocks.zh: 模組化牆體與天花板系統可縮短施工時間，並提供未來擴建、重新配置或搬遷的彈性。
blocks.en: Modular wall and ceiling systems can shorten construction time and provide flexibility for future expansion, reconfiguration or relocation.

blocks.zh: 4.3.10 消防與逃生
blocks.en: 4.3.10 Fire Protection and Egress

blocks.zh: 建築設計元件的耐火時限要求
blocks.en: Fire resistance rating requirements for building design elements

blocks.zh: 建築分艘化：將火災隔離在特定區域
blocks.en: Building compartmentation: isolating a fire within a specific area

blocks.zh: 人員緊急逃生路徑
blocks.en: Emergency escape routes for personnel

blocks.zh: 防止火焰、高溫氣體與煙霧透過水平/垂直通路擴散
blocks.en: Preventing the spread of flames, hot gases and smoke through horizontal/vertical paths
